The resource group ID of the host group. You can use a resource group ID to filter no more than 1,000 host groups.

> A default resource group is not supported.

The tags of the host group.

description.zh:
专有宿主机组的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个。如果资源数量超过1000个，请使用[ListTagResources](~~110425~~)接口进行查询。
description.en:
The tag key. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. It can be up to 64 characters in length, and can neither contain `http://` or `https://` nor `acs:` or `aliyun`.

You can filter no more than 1,000 host groups, regardless of how many tags are used. To query more than 1,000 host groups, call the [ListTagResources](~~110425~~) API operation.

description.zh: 专有宿主机组的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value cannot be an empty string. It can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

title.zh: 查询专有宿主机组的详情

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

请求参数的作用类似于一个过滤器，过滤器为逻辑与（AND）关系。如果某一参数为空，则过滤器不起作用。但是参数`DedicatedHostClusterIds`的值如果是一个空JSON数组，即`[]`，则视为该过滤器有效，且返回值为空。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

You can specify multiple request parameters to filter query results. Specified request parameters have logical AND relations. Only the specified parameters are included in the filter conditions. However, if `DedicatedHostClusterIds` is set to an empty JSON array (`[]`), this parameter is regarded as a valid filter condition and an empty result is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-dedicated-host-clusters --status example-string --lock-reason example-string --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-f --dedicated-host-cluster-ids dc-bp12wlf6am0vz9v20000_,_dc-bp12wlf6am0vz9v30000 --dedicated-host-cluster-name myDDHCluster --page-number 1 --page-size 5 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeDedicatedHostClusters --region cn-hangzhou --Status 'example-string' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-f' --DedicatedHostClusterName myDDHCluster --PageSize 5 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --LockReason 'example-string' --DedicatedHostClusterIds 'dc-bp12wlf6am0vz9v20000_,_dc-bp12wlf6am0vz9v30000'
